title: Do Borrowers Intentionally Avoid Covenant Violations? A Reexamination of the Debt Covenant Hypothesis

scopes.description: The complete author-documented SAS preparation workflow: Compustat and Dealscan preparation, three covenant sample exports, manual EDGAR contract review and threshold spreadsheet completion, then three SAS import/merge/preparation programs and their Stata exports. The bundled Stata files are described as sample identifiers, not analysis panels; no separate analysis-only scope is supported by this package.
